- [LLEX.10.2] `TYPE_SYM` is `NAME` plus the non-XID unit glyphs, lexed only in
  type positions ([LGRA.2.5.3]).

  A run that contains one of [LLEX.12.2]'s unit glyphs, after
  [LLEX.12.2.1]'s normalisation, and is not a legal `NAME` under [LNAM.2.5.1],
  the lexer **must** read as a `TYPE_SYM`, not refuse as an identifier. So `kΩ`
  and `μs` are unit symbols although each mixes Latin with Greek. [LNAM.2.5.1]
  still governs every `NAME`: a `TYPE_SYM` stands only where a type or unit is
  expected and resolves only against declared units, so it binds no name.
